body:
## Pull request overview

Promotes i18n to a core kernel service by adding an in-memory fallback implementation and wiring REST route registration/config so baseline i18n endpoints are available without explicit plugin configuration.

**Changes:**
- Updated the spec’s service criticality to make `i18n` a `core` service and documented the new default behavior.
- Added an in-memory `II18nService` fallback (`createMemoryI18n`) and registered it in `CORE_FALLBACK_FACTORIES`.
- Added REST server config (`enableI18n`) and route registration for i18n endpoints; corrected discovery/provider naming for i18n.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 11 out of 11 changed files in this pull request and generated 5 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/spec/src/system/core-services.zod.ts | Marks `i18n` as a core service requirement. |
| packages/spec/src/system/core-services.test.ts | Updates expectations for `i18n` criticality. |
| packages/spec/src/api/rest-server.zod.ts | Adds `enableI18n` flag to REST API config schema. |
| packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts | Registers i18n routes behind `enableI18n`. |
| packages/rest/src/rest.test.ts | Adds tests asserting i18n routes are registered / can be skipped. |
| packages/objectql/src/protocol.ts | Fixes i18n provider name used in discovery config. |
| packages/core/src/fallbacks/memory-i18n.ts | Introduces in-memory i18n fallback service implementation. |
| packages/core/src/fallbacks/index.ts | Exports `createMemoryI18n` and adds it to core fallback factories. |
| packages/core/src/fallbacks/fallbacks.test.ts | Adds unit tests for the i18n fallback and updates factory count. |
| content/docs/guides/kernel-services.mdx | Documents i18n as core with built-in fallback. |
| CHANGELOG.md | Records the feature and related behavior changes. |
</details>

Discovery uses `SERVICE_CONFIG` to advertise i18n availability, and RestServer now mounts `/api/v1/i18n/*` routes that call `protocol.getLocales/getTranslations`. However, `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation` does not implement these optional i18n methods, so the endpoints will consistently return 501 even when the kernel has auto-injected the i18n fallback service. Implement `getLocales`, `getTranslations` (and ideally `getFieldLabels`) in `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation` by reading the registered `i18n` service from `getServicesRegistry()` and shaping the responses to the spec schemas.

This section lists `getFieldLabels` as an i18n service method, but `II18nService` does not define `getFieldLabels` (it’s only present on the HTTP/protocol surface, and even there it’s optional/derivable). Update the doc to avoid implying the kernel i18n service must implement `getFieldLabels` (e.g., mark it as optional or move it under protocol endpoints).

RestServer doesn’t register any `/api/v1/i18n/labels/...` endpoint, but the client calls `/i18n/labels/:object?locale=...` and the protocol spec defines `getFieldLabels`. Without this route, `client.i18n.getFieldLabels()` will fail for RestServer-based deployments. Add a labels endpoint (query-style and/or `/:object/:locale`) that forwards to `protocol.getFieldLabels` when available.
